articles.title: Motorcyclist, 30, dies after accident involving lorry at West Coast Ferry Road
articles.summary:
📰 교육, 국제 관련 뉴스
📢 Motorcyclist, 30, dies after accident involving lorry at West Coast Ferry Road
articles.content: A 30-year-old motorcyclist died after an accident involving a lorry near West Coast Park on Tuesday (Oct 20) morning. A pool of blood is also visible beside a motorcycle bearing a Malaysian licence plate. A 30-year-old male motorcyclist was taken unconscious to National University Hospital where he subsequently died. A 24-year-old male lorry driver was arrested for driving without reasonable consideration causing death
